card.name: Start of words in all-caps headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word split up inside an ALL-CAPS heading, often a drug name after words like USE OF or TO. It fires on the opening or middle piece, not the end.

modes.label: Drug names in warning headings
modes.description: Opening piece of a capitalized drug name in a boxed warning or section title.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF CARDIAC ARREST WITH USE OF<< BU>>PIVACAINE HYDROCH

modes.label: Other capitalized headings
modes.description: Opening piece of a name or topic word in a capitalized title outside drug labels.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word-continuing pieces in capitals and away from words like bring or handing.
card.plain: It lights up on the first chunk of a long word written in capital letters in a heading, such as a drug name in a warning title.
